research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Impossible Foods is researching non-animal-based whole-cut food products that simulate aligned meat fibers and ground meat replicas that mimic fibrousness, heterogeneity, flavor, and color change. They develop methods and compositions for consumables, including plant based meat substitutes, cheese replicas from non-dairy milks, and non-animal meat replicas with heme-containing proteins, alongside protein purification, reductant treatment methods, flavor and aroma modulation, and secretion of heme-containing polypeptides. These efforts span plant-based meat, dairy, and processing technologies.

overview_description.description:
Impossible Foods focuses on developing plant-based substitutes for meat, dairy, and fish products. It selects specific proteins and nutrients from greens, seeds, and grains to recreate the experience of meats and dairy products.

Founded by Patrick Brown and Monte Casino in 2011, Impossible Foods is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
